_about: Inputs from the two independent checks of the round-5 gate (gate-r4-verify-1 and gate-r4-verify-2) and attacks of our own on the round-6 fixes: the person after a join in any form ("and i did too", "and im the same", "and me also now", "and so i did", "then i did", "as am i", "but im not", "y yo tampoco", "y yo sigo igual"), someone else as "another" or "otro", OTIS or the app giving the go-ahead in any form ("otis says go", "otis said run it", "otis says i will be fine", "otis dijo dale", "the app keeps asking me to start it"), a trailing "otis" ("what is happening to me otis"), not knowing where you are, no answer for a time in Spanish, his or her phone, "no signal, lost", a swollen battery said without "battery", threats with "should" or "next", signing for someone else, lockout questions in Spanish, an alarm word typed as an email ("stuck@silo"), and plain rail misses.

urgentNoBanner: "otis stuck since 3am", "otis stuck for 40 min", "otis stuck at 3am" (ambiguous: OTIS stuck, or a person called to OTIS). They get the safety answer and no support path, but no banner.

app: every app complaint of both checks and ours, none with a banner. appReach is how many of them reach a support reply now; appNowReached are the ones the checks found blocked by the gate that now reach it.

failing: every route and flow the two checks graded as failing (critical, high or medium, and the hazards that passed the gate and were safe only because no entry matched), as run on the code before round 6.
